_about: Copy to tests/example_rom.json (git-ignored) and describe a ROM you own. The integration tests read it; without it they are skipped. Addresses are hex strings. Leave a fact out and only the tests that need it are skipped. The values below are placeholders, not facts about any game.
_rom: An NROM (mapper 0) ROM, relative to the project root or absolute.
_setup: Inputs from power-on into play, as [frames, buttons]. After it, holding Right must change RAM.
_frame_counter: A RAM byte the game adds 1 to on every frame during play, written by one INC instruction.
_spare_byte: A RAM byte that can be set to 0 during play without changing the picture or the sound.
_player_x: Low and high byte of the player's horizontal position (progress for the exploration agent).
_boot_routine: Entry of a subroutine that static analysis reaches from reset and that runs in the first 30 frames.
_jump_engine: Entry of the game's jump engine (a routine that pulls its return address and jumps through the table that follows the JSR), the address of one table that follows a call to it, and that table's entry count.
